name: hover-reveal-matrix
title: Hover Reveal Matrix
description: A matrix grid of tiles where individual cells light up with proximity bloom as mouse travels over the array.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Grid Cell Proximity Illumination: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
